summary: Sanofi filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its 2026 global employee stock purchase plan (Action 2026). Eligible employees in 52 countries may subscribe for shares at €59.87, a 20% discount to the 20-day VWAP, with a 1-for-5 matching share grant (max 4). Up to 9,816,701 new shares are offered; the plan runs June 9–29, 2026, with delivery by end-July 2026. Shares are fully fungible with existing ordinary shares and carry voting rights. This is a routine employee equity offering, not a special situation—no change of control, activist campaign, or strategic inflection.
